text_block_list.text:
Waaagh! I lost again! I'm on a losing
streak!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
This is proof I still lack power. My
muscles weren't
enough to break
ahead...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I can't forgive myself for being so weak!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I need to redouble my training sets
ASAP!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... There's not a minute to waste!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: Okay, but let's not overdo it with the training.
You know what they say, time is muscle!

text_block_list.text:
Urk! Y-you're right... Even if I up my
workouts, my
muscles won't improve
immediately.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But if I don't work out enough, I'll get
bummed
out!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That's right! Gotta spend some to gain
some!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
A jacked body will never let you down,
so...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I gotta put more muscle into my training!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
P-please... just let me do a hundred
squats!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
